test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating custom field name and description in Settings
test.description:
This test verifies updating custom field name and description in Settings.

Covered areas:

* Settings → Fields
* OKR Detail page
* Overview (inline editing)
* Side panel
* Tree view
* Column layout

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving custom field name
* Verifying validation for custom field names exceeding 40 characters
* Editing and saving custom field description
* Verifying long custom field descriptions are displayed correctly with tooltip 
* Verifying Type, Used in and Allow multiple users fields are read-only during custom field editing
* Verifying updated custom field name is displayed correctly across all supported OKR views
* Verifying updated custom field description is saved correctly in Settings

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

* User custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for User fields
